verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only single-item actions: Request fix per finding, triaging findings via the API or MCP, and picking repositories at install time. Nothing documents a bulk operation such as multi-select triage, batch fixes or a bulk API endpoint. API and MCP primitives that a developer could script into bulk behavior are building blocks, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
